mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant App as app_start
  participant Supervisor
  participant Control as motor_control
  participant TIM1
  participant ADC as ADC1 and ADC2
  participant ISR as ADC interrupt and fast-sample callback
  participant MotorHW as motor_hw
  participant Console as USART2 console
  participant Command as command task
  participant UI as UI task
  participant Telemetry as telemetry task
  participant TX as TX task

  Boot->>App: Create queues and FreeRTOS tasks
  App->>Supervisor: Start supervisor task
  Supervisor->>MotorHW: motor_hw_bind_platform
  Supervisor->>Control: motor_control_init
  Supervisor->>Control: Register fast sample callback
  Supervisor->>TIM1: Start PWM and recurring sample trigger
  TIM1->>ADC: TRGO2 OC4REF triggers injected conversions

  par Fast current-control path
    loop Each paired ADC sample at PWM rate
      ADC->>ISR: ADC1_2 interrupt with conversion results
      ISR->>Control: Deliver current sample callback
      Control->>Control: Validate sample, update motor state and run FOC
      alt Sample valid and fault-free
        Control->>MotorHW: Update three PWM compare duties
        MotorHW->>TIM1: Set TIM1 CH1–CH3 compare values
      else Invalid sample or fault detected
        Control->>MotorHW: Disable bridge outputs
      end
    end
  and Console command path
    loop While command task runs
      Console->>MotorHW: USART2 RX interrupt supplies byte
      MotorHW->>Command: uart_rx_pop byte
      Command->>Command: Assemble and parse command line
      alt Command is valid
        Command->>Control: Apply start, stop, speed, direction, or source request
        Command->>TX: Queue command reply
      else Command is malformed
        Command->>TX: Queue error reply
      end
    end
  and UI path
    loop Every 20 ms
      UI->>MotorHW: Read PC13 button state
      UI->>Control: On debounced release, clear fault, start, or stop
      UI->>MotorHW: Write PA5 state indication
    end
  and Telemetry path
    loop Every 100 ms
      Telemetry->>Control: Read motor snapshot
      Telemetry->>TX: Queue CSV telemetry
      opt Motor idle with potentiometer input available
        Telemetry->>MotorHW: Read potentiometer ADC value
        Telemetry->>Control: Set source and requested speed when input is in range
      end
    end
  and UART output path
    loop As messages are queued
      TX->>TX: Prefer status replies over telemetry
      TX->>MotorHW: uart_tx message
      MotorHW->>Console: HAL_UART_Transmit
    end
  end
title: Sequence Diagram
